Short, plain guides to Kalos on the Elysium testnet: the DEX, NFTs and Drops, Social and Points.

Search guides

13 guides

Getting started
Getting started on the Elysium testnet

Connect a wallet, get free test HYPE from the faucet and learn what testnet means: nothing here has real value.

2 min read
Wrapping and unwrapping HYPE

What WHYPE is and why NFT offers use it, how to wrap and unwrap HYPE in your wallet panel, and what the Kalos Allowance does.

2 min read
Staying safe

Never share your seed phrase, read what you sign, know what each approval allows, and spot testnet scams before they cost you.

3 min read
DEX
Swapping tokens

Swap on the DEX: price impact, max slippage from 0.01% to 5%, minimum received, pool fees, the route, network fees and the final check.

3 min read
Adding liquidity

Deposit two tokens into a pool to earn its swap fees: full range or custom range, pool fee tiers, approvals and the deposit review.

3 min read
Impermanent loss explained

Why a liquidity position can be worth less than holding the same tokens, a worked example with numbers, when it matters and how fees offset it.

3 min read
Collecting fees and removing liquidity

Read a position card, move uncollected fees to your wallet with Collect, and take your tokens out with Remove, in part or in full.

2 min read
Staking KALOS

Stake KALOS for stKALOS on the DEX Stake tab, how the stKALOS rate grows with rewards, and how to unstake any time with no lock.

2 min read
Claiming airdrops

How to tell whether your wallet has a token airdrop, where to claim it on the DEX, and what to check before you confirm.

2 min read
NFTs and Drops
Buying, listing and offers on NFTs

Buy one NFT or a cart, sweep the floor, list one NFT or many, make item and collection offers in WHYPE, and accept offers.

3 min read
Minting from Drops

Find a live drop, see who
